purpose: Sanitized manifest for the exhaustive iCloud-mail profile analysis. It records coverage, classification rules, and safe aggregate signals without copying raw personal correspondence into Git.

attachment_coverage.limitation: Indexed email text is available for exhaustive message-level analysis, but attachment bodies are not exhausted because 231 of 232 attachment records expose metadata only.

strongest: Direct replies from known people or organizations
Offer, interview, enrollment, lease, service, and other transactional confirmations
Repeated behavior across months or years
weak_or_non_authoritative: Accessory purchases as proof of current device ownership
Household purchases as proof of the user's own hobby
evidence_policy.historical_state_rule: A dated email is evidence of state at that date. It must not silently overwrite newer user-stated or newer corroborated state.
evidence_policy.conflict_rule: Prefer newer direct user statements or confirmations; retain older evidence as timeline provenance rather than flattening it into current state.
evidence_policy.negative_inference_rule: Absence of email evidence is not evidence that something did not happen.

excluded_from_git: credentials, product keys, reset links, verification codes, and security artifacts
privacy_policy.handling: Sensitive source material may be encountered during local analysis but must not be promoted into the Git-tracked personal profile unless the user explicitly asks for that specific class of information and it is appropriate to retain.

analysis_passes_completed: All 203 Sent Messages reviewed as highest-value autobiographical evidence
Self-referential statements extracted from Sent Messages
Career/application/interview correspondence cross-checked against direct institutional replies
Education, housing, travel, vehicle, technology, hobbies, household, paid-research, and creator/subscription signals targeted
Attachment inventory classified by type and extraction availability
False-positive controls applied to marketing, recommendations, job alerts, and household/device ambiguity
next_deepening_targets: Build evidence-backed personal timeline with first/last-seen dates
Build relationship/organization graph without contact details
Separate direct applications/interviews from automated job alerts
Extract recurring commitments and follow-up behavior
Model interest evolution and digital-service history
Generate automation opportunities from repeated manual workflows
Recover/extract attachment bodies as a separate corpus if source files become available
